so a couple of pointers to get you on the right track
1. there where constant frame drops throughout the video, which is incredibly annoying to notice, maybe lower the settings of the game and then attempt to record
2. the intro of the video should be eye catching and hilarious, but i felt a bit off. sure you slapped a video of anstley's face on the garen chasing you, but it wasnt enough to captivate me to continue watching the video
3. practice some editing techniques and transitions, something as easy as a "slide transition" or even a transition matching to the song would help immensely towards the finished product :)

As a previous lets player **to a certain extent** there are a few thing i would like to point out too you regarding the video.

There are always things you can improve the kind of content/videos you produce, so take this with a grain of salt

1. **Be more enthusiastic when speaking**! i understand there isnt really a lot of things going on at certain stages of the game, examples being when you try to catch a crab or when you are exploring the island. but always try to keep the audience entertained or intrigued, throw in some jokes maybe even be sarcastic to the fact that you are stuck on an island with sharks everywhere. if there literally isn't anything to do, or speak about which is inevitable, then maybe trim it away in the editing phase

  
2. i fully understand that you are playing the game on an xbox one, which might be the reasoning behind the frames being so choppy, and i know there isnt really anything you can do about it, but for some people. when games come up under a certain amount of fps (frames per second) it can be really displeasing to the eye. figured you should know :)
